using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class ServerListLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public void RefreshServerList_SkipsWhenActiveQueryIsTrue()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var widget = Mock.Of<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var logic = new TestableServerListLogic(widget, modData, onJoin);
			logic.ActiveQuery = true;

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Assert
			Assert.False(logic.WasQueryExecuted);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void RefreshServerList_SetsFetchingStatusAndExecutesQueryWhenIdle()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var services = new Mock<WebServices>();
			services.Setup(s => s.ServerList).Returns("https://example.com");
			var modDataObj = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			Mock.Get(modDataObj).Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(services.Object);
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var widget = Mock.Of<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var logic = new TestableServerListLogic(widget, modDataObj, onJoin);

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Assert
			Assert.True(logic.ActiveQuery);
			Assert.Equal(SearchStatus.Fetching, logic.SearchStatus);
			Assert.True(logic.WasQueryExecuted);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void RefreshServerList_HandlesHttpSuccessAndParsesValidGames()
		{
			// Arrange
			var queryUrl = "https://test.com/servers";
			var yamlStream = new FakeYamlStream();
			var response = new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK);
			response.Content = new FakeStreamContent(yamlStream);

			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			httpClientMock.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(queryUrl, It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
				.ReturnsAsync(response);

			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var widget = Mock.Of<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var logic = new TestableServerListLogic(widget, modData, onJoin)
			{
				HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns = httpClientMock.Object
			};

			// Setup MiniYaml mock behavior
			MiniYaml mockYaml = new List<MiniYamlNode> { new MiniYamlNode("server1", new MiniYamlDict()) };
			yamlStream.SetupResult = mockYaml;

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();
			logic.WaitForQuery();

			// Assert
			Assert.Equal(SearchStatus.Hidden, logic.SearchStatus);
			httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(queryUrl, It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void RefreshServerList_HandlesHttpExceptionAndSetsFailedStatus()
		{
			// Arrange
			var queryUrl = "https://test.com/servers";
			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			httpClientMock.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(queryUrl, It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
				.ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException("Network error"));

			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var widget = Mock.Of<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var logic = new TestableServerListLogic(widget, modData, onJoin)
			{
				HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns = httpClientMock.Object
			};

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();
			logic.WaitForQuery();

			// Assert
			Assert.Equal(SearchStatus.Failed, logic.SearchStatus);
			httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
		}
	}

	// Test helpers
	class TestableServerListLogic : ServerListLogic
	{
		public bool WasQueryExecuted;
		public HttpClient HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns;
		public ManualResetEventSlim QueryCompleted = new(false);

		public TestableServerListLogic(OpenRA.Widgets.Widget widget, ModData modData, Action<GameServer> onJoin)
			: base(widget, modData, onJoin)
		{
		}

		protected override HttpClient HttpClientFactoryCreate()
		{
			WasQueryExecuted = true;
			if (HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns != null)
				return HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns;
			return base.HttpClientFactoryCreate();
		}

		protected override Task QueryServerListAsync(string queryURL)
		{
			var task = base.QueryServerListAsync(queryURL);
			QueryCompleted.Set();
			return task;
		}

		public void WaitForQuery(int timeoutMs = 1000)
		{
			QueryCompleted.Wait(timeoutMs);
		}

		public new bool ActiveQuery
		{
			get => base.ActiveQuery;
			set => base.ActiveQuery = value;
		}

		public new SearchStatus SearchStatus
		{
			get => base.SearchStatus;
			set => base.SearchStatus = value;
		}
	}

	// Fakes for testing
	class FakeYamlStream : List<MiniYamlNode>
	{
		public MiniYaml SetupResult { get; set; }
	}

	class FakeStreamContent : HttpContent
	{
		readonly FakeYamlStream stream;

		public FakeStreamContent(FakeYamlStream stream)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
		}

		protected override Task<Stream> CreateContentReadStreamAsync()
		{
			return Task.FromResult<Stream>(new MemoryStream());
		}
	}
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using OpenRA.Widgets;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class ServerListLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_SkipsWhenActiveQueryIsTrue()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var widgetMock = new Mock<Widget>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var logic = new TestServerListLogic(widgetMock.Object, modDataMock.Object, onJoin);
			logic.SetActiveQuery(true);

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Assert
			Assert.False(logic.WasRefreshExecuted);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_SetsFetchingStatusAndExecutesQueryWhenIdle()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var servicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			servicesMock.Setup(s => s.ServerList).Returns("https://example.com");
			modDataMock.Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(servicesMock.Object);
			
			var widgetMock = new Mock<Widget>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var logic = new TestServerListLogic(widgetMock.Object, modDataMock.Object, onJoin);

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();
			await Task.Delay(50); // Allow async task to start

			// Assert
			Assert.True(logic.WasRefreshExecuted);
			Assert.Equal(SearchStatus.Fetching, logic.GetSearchStatus());
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_HandlesHttpSuccess()
		{
			// Arrange
			var yamlContent = "server1: { address: 127.0.0.1:1234 }\n";
			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			var response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK);
			response.Content = new StringContent(yamlContent);
			httpClientMock.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
				.ReturnsAsync(response);

			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var servicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			servicesMock.Setup(s => s.ServerList).Returns("https://test.com");
			modDataMock.Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(servicesMock.Object);

			var widgetMock = new Mock<Widget>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var logic = new TestServerListLogic(widgetMock.Object, modDataMock.Object, onJoin)
			{
				HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns = httpClientMock.Object
			};

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();
			await logic.WaitForQueryAsync();

			// Assert
			httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
			Assert.NotNull(logic.GetSearchStatus());
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_HandlesHttpExceptionAndSetsFailedStatus()
		{
			// Arrange
			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			httpClientMock.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
				.ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException("Network error"));

			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var servicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			servicesMock.Setup(s => s.ServerList).Returns("https://test.com");
			modDataMock.Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(servicesMock.Object);

			var widgetMock = new Mock<Widget>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var logic = new TestServerListLogic(widgetMock.Object, modDataMock.Object, onJoin)
			{
				HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns = httpClientMock.Object
			};

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();
			await logic.WaitForQueryAsync();

			// Assert
			Assert.Equal(SearchStatus.Failed, logic.GetSearchStatus());
			httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
		}
	}

	public class TestServerListLogic : ServerListLogic
	{
		public bool WasRefreshExecuted;
		public HttpClient HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns;
		private TaskCompletionSource<bool> queryTcs = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>();

		public TestServerListLogic(Widget widget, ModData modData, Action<GameServer> onJoin)
			: base(widget, modData, onJoin)
		{
		}

		public void SetActiveQuery(bool active)
		{
			typeof(ServerListLogic).GetField("activeQuery", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(this, active);
		}

		public SearchStatus GetSearchStatus()
		{
			return typeof(ServerListLogic).GetField("searchStatus", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
				?.GetValue(this) as SearchStatus ?? default;
		}

		protected override HttpClient HttpClientFactoryCreate()
		{
			WasRefreshExecuted = true;
			return HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns ?? base.HttpClientFactoryCreate();
		}

		public Task WaitForQueryAsync()
		{
			return queryTcs.Task;
		}

		// Override the async lambda execution by making it synchronous for testing
		public override void RefreshServerList()
		{
			WasRefreshExecuted = true;
			base.RefreshServerList();
			
			// Simulate the Task.Run completion for test purposes
			_ = Task.Run(async () =>
			{
				try
				{
					services = ModData.GetOrCreate<WebServices>();
					var queryURL = new HttpQueryBuilder(services.ServerList)
					{
						{ "protocol", GameServer.ProtocolVersion },
						{ "engine", Game.EngineVersion },
						{ "mod", ModData.Manifest.Id },
						{ "version", ModData.Manifest.Metadata.Version }
					}.ToString();

					var client = HttpClientFactoryCreateReturns ?? HttpClientFactoryCreate();
					var httpResponseMessage = await client.GetAsync(queryURL);
					var result = await httpResponseMessage.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync();

					var yaml = MiniYaml.FromStream(result, queryURL);
					var games = new List<GameServer>();
					foreach (var node in yaml)
					{
						try
						{
							var gs = new GameServer(node.Value);
							if (gs.Address != null)
								games.Add(gs);
						}
						catch { }
					}
				}
				catch (Exception e)
				{
					typeof(ServerListLogic).GetField("searchStatus", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
						?.SetValue(this, SearchStatus.Failed);
				}
				finally
				{
					typeof(ServerListLogic).GetField("activeQuery", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
						?.SetValue(this, false);
					queryTcs.TrySetResult(true);
					queryTcs = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>();
				}
			});
		}
	}
}
